about.name: mission
about.text:
At ODIN Diagnostics we are committed to making a significant leap forward in brain health. Our team comprises a diverse group of interdisciplinary engineers, entrepreneurs, and athletes united by a shared passion for creating a safer future and driving meaningful change.

We understand the complexities of concussions and are committed to addressing these challenges head-on. Our mission is to redefine concussion care to preserve brain health. We aim to prevent further damage after injury through early detection and intervention and by guiding evidence-based treatments to reduce long-term effects.

We are driven to make a lasting impact and enhance safety across all areas where brain injuries occur.

items.title: CONNOR HEFFLER
items.subtitle: Founder & CEO
items.text: With a background in Economics and Entrepreneurship, Connor brings personal experience to this issue, having suffered prior concussions as a Division-1 football player at Cal Poly. He has witnessed firsthand the devastating impact of these injuries on his teammates–many of whom lost their athletic careers from concussions and still battle with long-term effects. This deep understanding of the problem drives our commitment to developing a meaningful solution. His role includes business and customer development, business strategy, operations, team leadership, partnerships, IP strategy, and fundraising.

items.title: MARINA ZELLERS
items.subtitle: Product Manager
items.text: With a master’s degree in biomedical engineering and a concentration in bioinstrumentation, Marina brings expertise in medical technology, regulatory processes, and user-centered design. In the corporate space, she has written and executed test protocols, collaborated with vendors to resolve product issues, and optimized surgical planning processes through data-driven refinements. Her role includes clinical testing and validation, regulatory and clinical compliance, optimizing user experience and human factors, and virtual reality engineering.

items.title: CONNOR FOURT
items.subtitle: Software Architect
items.text: With over seven years of experience in building web applications at software startups in the IT space, Connor brings expertise in software engineering and delivering value through innovative solutions. In the corporate space, he wore many hats where he previously held positions such as developer, engineering manager, designer, and also delved into customer support, quality assurance, and sales. His role includes software architecting, application scalability, software engineering, and product roadmapping.
